title: Jack Gordon's three unnamed aircraft

tellings.quote: I've I've been responsible for 15 real flying uh aircraft in my time.

plain: Nick Cook says that Jack Gordon, a former head of Skunk Works, Lockheed's secret aircraft plant at Palmdale, California, told him in the mid-1990s, "I've been responsible for 15 real flying aircraft in my time", more than the public record shows, which leaves three aircraft that have never been named. Cook tells Michels this as what Gordon said to him in person. If true, aircraft that the public has never heard of have been built and flown.
